hits.title: Circulating long RNA for functional profiling of cancer patients.
hits.snippet: Wobble Genomics has just demonstrated that their circulating long RNA diagnostic platform has achieved a limit of detection which surpasses the current industry leader, Personalis, by more than an order of magnitude.

hits.title: Tempus to acquire Personalis for $1.5B, deepening bet on cancer diagnostics.
hits.snippet: On the numbers, Personalis reported preliminary Q2 revenue of $22.4 million and delivered 10,384 tests, up 33% from Q1.

hits.title: Personalis, Yale Launch Trial to Measure Clinical Utility of ctDNA-Guided Breast Cancer Treatment
hits.snippet: NEW YORK - Personalis said Wednesday that it has entered a collaboration with the Yale Cancer Center for a clinical trial titled CATE to evaluate a strategy of circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA)-guided treatment in women with hormone receptor-positive HER2-negative breast cancer.
